common_decisions.C1: Data: synthetic data only. For TOKEN, no data is generated about people; the benchmark is the public ARC-Challenge set, whose download the owner approved specifically for this project (approvals file, TOKEN section). The 10-item synthetic fixture is used for tests only.
common_decisions.C2: PDFs: pandoc and Typst with -V mainfont="Libertinus Serif"; no LaTeX on the machine.
common_decisions.C3: Authorship: "Mohamed Bechir Kefi", no affiliation. The AI is disclosed as a research and development assistant, not as an author.
common_decisions.C4: Disclosure: no real model output and no ARC item was seen before the freeze. The only primary-contrast values computed were from the SIMULATED backend (no model, deterministic hash of the prompt) on the 10-item synthetic fixture, in the exploratory runs RUN-SMOKE-0001 to RUN-SMOKE-0004 (JRN-0003): strict extraction, Delta(A1 - A0) = -30.0 pp (95% CI -60.0 to 0.0, McNemar p 0.25, Holm 0.5) and Delta(A2 - A0) = +10.0 pp (95% CI -30.0 to 50.0, p 1.0, Holm 1.0), identical in all four runs and under lenient extraction. Stored in results/exploratory/RUN-SMOKE-000{1,2,3,4}/contrasts.csv and result.json. They carry no information about the models. The real-runtime smoke attempt (JRN-0002) produced no output (server down).

git_revision_note: Commit holding exactly the frozen protocols and configs below; the freeze record itself is added in the next commit, which leaves those files unchanged.

EXP-002.config_note: Implements the frozen EXP-002 protocol (v1.0, unchanged, same SHA-256) items 9 to 12, 14, 17 and 18 with the runner's cold_warm design (token_lab.runner.run_cold_warm). Recorded under the owner's "Approve all" (2026-11-24, labs/_shared/owner-approvals-2026-11-24b.md, via labs/_shared/RATIFY-brief.md), which approved implementing this mode exactly as the frozen protocol defines it and recording the config hash here. Implementation choices inside the protocol's text: the fixed validation prompt is seeded_subset(validation, 1, seed 20261124) = Mercury_192290 rendered with T1; trials alternate starting cold; each cold trial unloads its arm's model and any other model /api/ps lists; no retries and no discarded warm-up (either would change the start state); unload confirmation polls /api/ps every 0.25 s for up to 30 s; a cold trial is kept but marked invalid if any model is listed just before the request. Not implemented: the item-20 page-cache sensitivity check (exploratory, not part of this config). Tested only with the simulated backend and the local HTTP stub; Ollama was not contacted.
